text:
In ancient times, people used a tool called a reed pen to write. They would dip the tip of the reed into ink and use it to make marks on papyrus, which was a type of paper made from plants.

We also learn about Ancient Egypt, a fascinating civilization from long ago. The Egyptians built massive stone structures called pyramids. These were not just buildings; they served as special tombs for their leaders, known as pharaohs. Pharaohs were like kings or queens, and the pyramids were built to honor them and help them on their journey to the afterlife.
